item.title: How to Run Stable Diffusion on macOS Without a GPU
item.description: 1. Recommended Configuration for Running Stable Diffusion Memory: at least 16 GB DDR4 or DDR5 Storage: at least 10 GB of free space GPU: an NVIDIA card with at least 6 GB of VRAM If your hardware falls short, you can also use one of the various optimized forks that support lower-spec hardware, but generation time will increase.
